avg_bars_held.definition: Mean holding period, in the run's bars.
avg_bars_held.label: Average bars held

cagr_pct.definition: Compound annual growth rate over the measured elapsed span of the equity curve.
cagr_pct.label: CAGR

calmar.definition: CAGR over the absolute max drawdown.
calmar.label: Calmar

cost_drag_pct.definition: Costs as a percentage of gross P&L (absolute).
cost_drag_pct.label: Cost drag

costs_paid.definition: Spread, commission, slippage and financing the engine charged, in the account currency.
costs_paid.label: Costs paid

deflated_sharpe.definition: The probabilistic Sharpe measured against the expected maximum Sharpe of N zero-skill trials, N being the trial count the experiment ledger records for this strategy's family or campaign. Below 0.95 the result is not distinguishable from the best of N coin flips.
deflated_sharpe.label: Deflated Sharpe

expectancy.definition: Mean net P&L per closed trade, in the account currency.
expectancy.label: Expectancy

expectancy_r.definition: Mean R multiple per trade: net P&L over the risk planned at entry. Trades with no recorded stop are excluded (the sample size says how many remain).
expectancy_r.formula: mean(net P&L_i / (|entry_i - stop_i| x size_i x contract x fx_i))
expectancy_r.label: Expectancy (R)

exposure_pct.definition: Share of the run's bars with at least one open position.
exposure_pct.label: Exposure

mae.definition: Maximum adverse excursion: the worst open P&L a trade reached, from the engine's per-bar high/low tracking, in the account currency.
mae.formula: min_t (worst price_t - entry) x direction x size x contract x fx
mae.label: MAE

max_drawdown_pct.definition: Deepest peak-to-trough fall of the mark-to-market equity curve, relative to the running peak.
max_drawdown_pct.label: Max drawdown

mfe.definition: Maximum favourable excursion: the best open P&L a trade reached.
mfe.formula: max_t (best price_t - entry) x direction x size x contract x fx
mfe.label: MFE

monthly_return.definition: Change of mark-to-market equity from the last point of the previous UTC month (or the initial equity) to the last point of the month.
monthly_return.label: Monthly return

net_profit.definition: Final equity less initial equity, after every cost the engine charged.
net_profit.label: Net profit

profit_factor.definition: Gross winning P&L over gross losing P&L. Undefined with no losing trade.
profit_factor.label: Profit factor

psr.definition: Probability that the true per-trade Sharpe exceeds zero, given the sample's length, skew and kurtosis (Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2012).
psr.formula: Z[ SR x sqrt(T - 1) / sqrt(1 - g3 SR + (g4 - 1)/4 SR^2) ]
psr.label: Probabilistic Sharpe

return_correlation.definition: Pearson correlation of daily mark-to-market returns on the trading days both runs have.
return_correlation.label: Return correlation

rolling_sharpe.definition: Sharpe of the trailing 63 trading days of daily returns, annualised by the measured trading days per year.
rolling_sharpe.formula: mean(r_d[t-w+1..t]) / sd(r_d[t-w+1..t]) x sqrt(days per year)
rolling_sharpe.label: Rolling Sharpe

sharpe.definition: Mean over standard deviation of daily mark-to-market returns (trading days end 17:00 New York), annualised by the measured trading days per year.
sharpe.formula: mean(r_d) / sd(r_d) x sqrt(days per year)
sharpe.label: Sharpe (daily)

sharpe_lo_adjusted.definition: The daily Sharpe corrected for autocorrelation of daily returns (Lo 2002).
sharpe_lo_adjusted.formula: SR_daily x eta(q), eta(q) = q / sqrt(q + 2 sum (q-k) rho_k)
sharpe_lo_adjusted.label: Sharpe (Lo-adjusted)

sortino.definition: Daily mean return over downside deviation, annualised.
sortino.formula: mean(r_d) / sqrt(mean(min(r_d, 0)^2)) x sqrt(days per year)
sortino.label: Sortino

total_return_pct.definition: Net profit as a percentage of initial equity.
total_return_pct.label: Total return

turnover.definition: Round-trip traded notional per year, as a multiple of mean equity.
turnover.formula: sum(2 x |size| x contract x entry x fx) / mean(E) / years
turnover.label: Turnover

underwater.definition: Distance of equity below its running peak at every point.
underwater.label: Underwater

win_rate_pct.definition: Share of closed trades with positive net P&L.
win_rate_pct.label: Win rate

caveats.message: Not recovered by the end of the run.

data.excursions_note: MAE and MFE are the engine's own per-bar excursions, recorded at the ledger boundary (backtest/position.py) in the account currency at the closing FX rate; in R when the trade's stop was recorded.

caveats: Sharpe here is PER TRADE, not annualised: trade returns are not calendar-spaced and annualising them would invent a frequency.
One backtest cannot produce the walk-forward, PBO, SPA, StepM or parameter-plateau numbers. Those gates are NOT_EVALUATED, which blocks promotion; run the full validation ladder to fill them.

the experiment ledger holds no trials for this strategy's family or campaign, so the size of the search is UNKNOWN and the deflated Sharpe is NOT_EVALUATED (it blocks). A payload trial count is never used: it is written by whoever wants the number.
